# Link between baseline intention and endline outcome: Alluvial plot on all

```{r}


library(ggalluvial)


# Ensure your data is in the correct format for ggalluvial
alluvial_data <- MainDB %>%
  dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, Assignment) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ChildcareTypeBaseline) & !is.na(ChildcareTypeEndline))

# Create the alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data,
       aes(axis1 = ChildcareTypeBaseline, axis2 = ChildcareTypeEndline)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = ChildcareTypeBaseline), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "gray") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Desired Care (During Pregnancy)", "Actual Care (Endline)"),
                   expand = c(0.15, 0.15)) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

On controls only with applications

```{r}

# Ensure your data is in the correct format for ggalluvial
alluvial_data_Controls <- Control %>%
  dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, ECSApp) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ChildcareTypeBaseline) & !is.na(ChildcareTypeEndline)) %>% 
  mutate(ECSApp = ifelse(ECSApp == 1, "Applied", "Did not apply"))

# Create the alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data_Controls,
       aes(axis1 = ChildcareTypeBaseline, axis2 = ECSApp, axis3 =  ChildcareTypeEndline)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = ChildcareTypeBaseline), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "gray") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Desired Care (During Pregnancy)", "Actual Care (Endline)"),
                   expand = c(0.15, 0.15)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Flow of Early Childcare Preferences to Actual Care",
       x = "Stages",
       y = "Number of Families")
       

```

Low-SES vs High SES

1\) High-SES

```{r}

  dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, ECSApp) %>%
```
